title: Crime and punishment — преступления и наказания

items.example: Two boys were caught writing large graffiti on a wall.

items.idiom: do unpaid work to help your town
items.translation: выполнять неоплачиваемую работу на пользу города
items.example: They do unpaid work to help their town or city.
He was cheating people to make money from them.
You have to pay an amount of money as a fine.

items.idiom: go sailing illegally in dangerous waters
items.translation: выйти под парусом незаконно в опасных водах
items.example: A couple went sailing illegally in dangerous waters.
A search team had to spend hours looking for them.

items.idiom: play loud music late at night
items.example: He was arrested for playing loud music late at night.
